original_test_intent: Run the approved vectorized-double Stream workload with 1,308,622,848 elements on the intended GPU and compare its reported bandwidth/performance with the authoritative DA-10997-001_v31 and Viking result.
original_method: Pin binary/source/hash and compatible runtime; map GPU UUID/BDF to -d; decide -r input mode; calculate element and auxiliary-buffer memory demand against free VRAM; preserve baseline and isolate jobs; run tracked exact workload with telemetry/timeout; capture complete metrics/units/exit; compare using approved reference/tolerance; release allocations and verify GPU/log health.
manual_activity: Application owner supplies verified tool/reference and parameters; operator maps GPU, approves memory/bandwidth load and recovery; agent may run the tracked benchmark after gates pass.
required_inputs: GPU UUID/BDF to -d selector mapping and approved -r setting
Memory-footprint formula/usable VRAM approval for n=1308622848
DA-10997-001_v31 and Viking reference revision with metric/units/tolerance
SUT isolation, telemetry thresholds, timeout and recovery approval
safety_requirements: Do not place an unverified executable in root
Preflight all buffers; stop before run if allocation margin is insufficient
Never rely on implicit GPU selection or random policy
Track process and abort on OOM/XID/thermal/power/management faults
Preserve logs and confirm allocations/processes are released
agent_execution_scope: Run exact approved argv as a tracked process
Collect metrics, telemetry, errors and cleanup evidence
Report comparison without owning DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve binary, GPU, random mode, memory budget and numeric oracle
Own recovery and disposition of metric/error deviations

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently defines the Stream binary, element count and DA/Viking reference; omitted selector/random/reference details are project inputs rather than contradictory source branches.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Binary, reference and runtime inputs are provisionable; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Adds deterministic device/input selection, allocation preflight and a traceable metric-to-reference comparison.
independent_technical_reasoning: The element count represents over ten gigabytes for one double array, and Stream-style kernels commonly use multiple arrays, so a simple free-memory check must use the implementation's buffer model. Default device ordinals and random-input defaults can alter both target and results. Performance evidence is meaningful only when the binary revision, metric units and reference tolerance are fixed.
